# Artizanni Business Services Limited

> Artizanni is an Abuja-based design-build firm (RC 1065469, since 2012): architecture, civil, structural and MEP engineering, construction, interiors, real estate, project and property management, and an escrow-backed property service for Nigerians abroad.

- Registered: CAC RC 1065469, incorporated 17 September 2012
- Head office: No. 30 Anthony Enahoro Street, Utako District, Abuja, FCT, Nigeria
- Managing Director: Engr. Akolade Maruf Ibrahim, MNSE, PMP · COREN Reg. No. R29685
- Escrow partner for diaspora clients: First Trustees
- Contact: WhatsApp/phone +234 701 802 4292, aec@artizanni.com, artizanni@gmail.com
